tasks.label: PIO: Free COM6 + Test
tasks.command: $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'platformio\.exe.*device monitor|platformio\.exe.*-t monitor|platformio\.exe.*monitor' }; foreach ($p in $procs) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; & 'C:/Users/Philip/.platformio/penv/Scripts/platformio.exe' test -e lolin32_lite --upload-port COM6
